variety.label: Modern Hebrew
variety.policyNoteEnglish: An authored set: present participles in four forms, and past paradigms. Forms are written out. This is not a complete conjugator.

review.noteEnglish: Original Hebrew teaching examples for English speakers. Independent native review is still required. Pointed Hebrew is the teaching script. No approved pronunciation or audio is claimed.

license.noteEnglish: First-party Hebrew curriculum. Release review is still required.
